note.en: One-shot Turf War agent by Claude Opus 5 (Max effort) in Claude Code 2.1.219 from the repository's canonical Chinese prompt (only the [This run] placeholders filled per case rules), with no human edits, 45 minutes 23 seconds. Run on a bare harness: all skills, plugins, MCP servers and external setting sources disabled, tools limited to Bash/Read/Edit/Write/Glob/Grep; the model never executed the policy or played a match. Per case rules the policy file is unpublished and no bug is ever fixed; this registers the maintainer-executed run. The produced file was only renamed to the model id, byte-identical otherwise. It named itself "画地为牢". The policy is a prefix-sum-scored rectangular loop planner with per-tick cut-off margin safety analysis and opportunistic trail hunting. Independent Arena diagnosis found the policy API-compliant; it lost both fixed diagnostic seeds against baseline-expander (133:1096 and 165:1009) while completing 383 and 430 captures respectively.
